name: start_plan
description:
Open the plan session for a customer's request to set up or reconfigure their system -- new installation, vacation mode, holidays, remodel, move, irrigation, and more (see the plan_type enum). The response gives you an `instruction` (how to approach it) and `available_tools` (the steps you can call via run_plan_step) -- read the instruction and follow it. Currently only `new_installation` is actually implemented; every other plan_type returns a `not_implemented` status instead of opening a session -- check for that before telling the customer you're proceeding.

Only one plan session can be open at a time, and while one is open, EVERY other tool (not just start_plan/run_plan_step) is refused -- same as an in-progress diagnostic session, and the two are mutually exclusive with each other too (starting a plan while a diagnostic is running, or vice versa, is refused) since both can drive real hub hardware.

Calling start_plan again while a session is already open just re-shows the same instruction/steps for the plan_type it was originally started with -- it does not restart or switch types. A session left open too long without concluding/stopping is treated as abandoned and cleared automatically, letting a new one start.

plan_type.description: Which kind of plan the customer wants. Only "new_installation" is currently functional -- every other value is a recognized but not-yet-available plan type.
